title: Q-KIT-IGNORANCE-1: carry IGNORANCE-1 into the seed kit
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/autonomy/system.json::not_in_kit
**Status:** open

SYSTEM-SPEC-1: the standing rule IGNORANCE-1 (The system knows what the user does not know) is enforced only by the platform (foundation/ignorance.py, ops/told.jsonl, python3 -m foundation ignorance --compute). A system built from the seed inherits the rule as an instruction but has no code here that enforces it.

Ship the check or loop that enforces IGNORANCE-1 into seed/ (a script under seed/scripts/, a tick step under seed/worker/src/, or a test under seed/tests/), add its probe to kit_enforcement in seed/autonomy/system.json, and remove IGNORANCE-1 from not_in_kit.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cd seed && python3 scripts/system.py --gaps prints no line for IGNORANCE-1, and python3 scripts/system.py --check passes.
